messages:
Mei: hey folks, opened a tiny PR to document JRuby support edgecases in the Ruby SDK, and add a smoke test for our sampleapp.
Tom: link?
Mei: https://github.com/redwood-inference/ruby-sdk/pull/128 - summary: add jruby CI job, note on extconf and ffi, adjust timeout default parity with Go SDK
Priya: quick q — what's the timeout parity? Ruby was 15s previously.
Mei: set default_read_timeout = 20s in PR to match Go's 20s; rationale: streaming responses often take longer during cold starts
Anya: hmm would prefer keeping 15s for low-latency clients. Could we make it configurable and document recommended values in sampleapp README?
Mei: made it an option in client initializer with default 20; added README guidance: 'set to 60s for large chat sessions'
Josh: CI is failing on ubuntu-latest with an ffi compile error on JRuby: "make failed: could not find mkmf" — probably missing build-essential on the runner
CI-Bot: build #452 failed: ext/ffi build error; logs: "checking for gcc... no"
Tom: we can add a smoke check in the PR that uses pure-ruby fallback when native ffi isn't available; less ideal but avoids CI break
Mei: added fallback + a matrix entry to skip native ext on JRuby in GH actions; also note in README that users on JRuby should install ruby-dev / build-essential
Priya: docs look good. One minor wording: 'install build tools' -> 'install development headers (ruby-dev / build-essential)'
Anya: can we also add a quick sample for token rotation in README sampleapp? People always get stuck on streaming reconnects after 401
Mei: added snippet:
```ruby
# simple token provider
class TokenProvider
  def initialize
    @token = nil
  end
  def get
    refresh_if_needed unless @token && !expired?
    @token
  end
  def refresh_if_needed
    @token = OAuth.refresh!
  end
end
client = Redwood::Client.new(token_provider: TokenProvider.new)
```
Tom: suggest showing how to handle 401 during streaming: reconnect once after token refresh and resume the stream with last event id
Mei: added a short paragraph and small test in spec/stream_retry_spec.rb that stubs 401 then 200
Priya: once CI green and the wording nit is fixed, +1 from me
Mei: thanks all, squashed and pushed
CI-Bot: build #453 queued
